cv:
André Ferreira
Product and UI/UX designer with 3 years of experience designing user flows, Design Systems, and responsive
SaaS web applications.
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Product Designer (UI/UX)
Aurora Digital | 2022-Present (2 years)
Designing interactive prototypes and high-fidelity UI specifications in Figma.
Building and maintaining component libraries and Design Systems.
Conducting user interviews, usability testing, and UX discovery.
Preparing design-to-development handoff documentation.
Junior UI/UX Designer
Studio Blend | 2021-2022 (1.5 years)
Creating wireframes, mockups, and responsive landing pages.
User journey mapping and persona definition.
EDUCATION
B.Sc. in Communication and Multimedia Design
Universidade do Minho (2018-2021)
DESIGN SKILLS
Tools: Figma, FigJam, Sketch, Adobe Creative Suite
Methods: Wireframing, Prototyping, Usability Testing, Information Architecture
Standards: Design Systems, Component Libraries, Accessibility (WCAG)
